abilities.description: On ability use, Gragas takes a drink, restoring some of his Health.
Gragas rolls a barrel that explodes after a short delay, damaging and slowing Attack Speed. Recast to detonate the barrel early.
Gragas guzzles down brew from his cask, restoring Mana. He then gains Attack Damage and reduces damage taken for several seconds.
Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, damaging nearby enemies and Slowing them.
Gragas hurls his cask, damaging and Knocking Away enemies from the impact.
